description:
Read a Markdown table (pipes optional at the ends, \| escapes,
as line breaks) back into data: JSON objects keyed by the header, JSON arrays, or CSV; also returns each column's alignment. Uses the website's Markdown import. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/markdown-table/

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a Markdown file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

text.description: The Markdown table as inline text.

name: markdown_table_parse
title: Markdown table to JSON / CSV
